allowed.item: alert('Failed to add creator. Please try again.')
allowed.why: Phase 5 (approved plan: replace alert()/confirm()): alert(message) became toast.error(message) with the same text; confirm(...) became await confirmDialog({...}), which resolves true only on the confirm button, like the browser's OK. Every call site was already inside an async function.

Read-only; also selects sessions.actual_minutes.
